nodes.label: NIST FIPS 204 ML-DSA (CRYSTALS-Dilithium) Post-Quantum Signature Standard
nodes.description: Primary post-quantum digital signature standard based on the hardness of lattice problems over module lattices (Module-LWE and Module-SIS).

nodes.label: Arabic-ALBERT Cross-Layer Parameter Sharing Transformer
nodes.description: Lightweight variant of BERT utilizing cross-layer parameter sharing and factorized embedding parameterization specialized for Modern Standard and Dialectal Arabic NLP tasks.

nodes.label: Roaring Bitmap Compressed Bitset Indexing Algorithm
nodes.description: Hybrid compressed bitset data structure utilizing uncompressed bitset arrays, run-length encoding, and short integer arrays for sub-millisecond sparse set intersections in graph engines.

nodes.label: W3C SHACL (Shapes Constraint Language) Standard
nodes.description: W3C specification for validating RDF graph structures against a set of structural conditions defined as shapes and constraints.

nodes.label: AMD SEV-SNP Secure Nested Paging Confidential Computing Engine
nodes.description: Hardware-enforced memory encryption architecture providing hypervisor memory protection, strong integrity guarantees, and remote attestation for sovereign workloads.
